name: Example: Flame and Lightning Gems
author: byo-pop examples
description: Bejeweled 2's special gems. A run of 4 leaves a flame gem, which blows up the gems around it when it is matched; a run of 5 leaves a lightning gem, which clears its row and column. A blast that catches another special sets it off too. Uses its own high-score table.

settings.label: Made by
settings.help: A run of 4: Bejeweled 2. Every match: each match leaves one, which makes for a lot of blasts.

settings.label: Blast size
settings.help: The square of gems a flame gem blows up. Bejeweled 2: 3 x 3.

settings.label: Points a gem
settings.help: For each gem a blast takes, times the multiplier.

settings.label: Made by

choices.label: A run of 5, an L or a T

settings.help: A run of 5: Bejeweled 2. With L and T, crossing runs of one colour join into one group and make one too.

settings.label: Points a gem
settings.help: For each gem a bolt takes, times the multiplier.

settings.label: Blasts set off specials
settings.help: A special caught in a blast goes off too.

settings.label: Only from your own moves
settings.help: On: specials form only in the matches a move makes, not in the cascades after it.
